---
title: Mastodon
description: Privacy rules for Mastodon 4.4 to 4.7 on PostgreSQL
---

Covers Mastodon users' e-mail and IP addresses, credentials, OAuth and push tokens, signing keys, moderation notes, public profiles, and post content.

## Coverage

- **Versions:** 4.4 to 4.7.
- **Engines:** PostgreSQL.
- **Table prefix:** the template assumes unprefixed table names. Mastodon uses no table prefix.

## Template

<Callout type="warn">
Do not also paste the [Devise (Rails)](/templates/devise) template: both rule the same `users` columns (`email`, `encrypted_password`, tokens), so the two cannot be pasted together; a repeated column stops startup.
</Callout>

```yaml
privacy:
  rules:
    emails:
      columns:
        - users.email
        - users.unconfirmed_email
        - email_subscriptions.email
        - canonical_email_blocks.canonical_email_hash
        - fasp_providers.contact_email
      entity: EMAIL_ADDRESS
      operator: hash
    names:
      columns:
        - webauthn_credentials.nickname
        # Public profiles (optional: published to every federated server)
        - accounts.username
        - accounts.display_name
        - account_aliases.acct
        - account_migrations.acct
        - relationship_severance_events.target_name
      entity: PERSON
      operator: hash
    user-ids:
      columns:
        - identities.uid
      entity: USER_ID
      operator: hash
    ip-addresses:
      columns:
        - users.sign_up_ip
        - login_activities.ip
        - session_activations.ip
        - oauth_access_tokens.last_used_ip
        - ip_blocks.ip
        - fasp_debug_callbacks.ip
      entity: IP_ADDRESS
      operator: hash
    user-agents:
      columns:
        - login_activities.user_agent
        - session_activations.user_agent
      entity: USER_AGENT
      operator: hash
    text:
      columns:
        - account_moderation_notes.content
        - report_notes.content
        - instance_moderation_notes.content
        - account_notes.comment
        - account_warnings.text
        - appeals.text
        - reports.comment
        - user_invite_requests.text
        - invites.comment
        - ip_blocks.comment
        - domain_blocks.private_comment
        # Post content (optional: statuses also holds direct messages)
        - statuses.text
        - statuses.spoiler_text
        - status_edits.text
        - status_edits.spoiler_text
        - status_edits.media_descriptions
        - status_edits.poll_options
        - media_attachments.description
        - polls.options
      entity: FREE_TEXT
      operator: replace
    passwords:
      columns:
        - users.encrypted_password
        - users.otp_backup_codes
      entity: PASSWORD_HASH
      operator: redact
    tokens:
      columns:
        - users.reset_password_token
        - users.confirmation_token
        - email_subscriptions.confirmation_token
        - session_activations.session_id
        - invites.code
        - generated_annual_reports.share_key
      entity: AUTH_TOKEN
      operator: redact
    otp-secrets:
      columns:
        - users.otp_secret
        - users.sign_in_token
      entity: OTP_SECRET
      operator: redact
    secrets:
      columns:
        - oauth_access_tokens.token
        - oauth_access_tokens.refresh_token
        - oauth_access_grants.token
        - oauth_access_grants.code_challenge
        - oauth_applications.secret
        - web_push_subscriptions.key_auth
        - web_push_subscriptions.key_p256dh
        - webhooks.secret
      entity: API_KEY
      operator: redact
    push-endpoints:
      columns:
        - web_push_subscriptions.endpoint
      entity: URL
      operator: redact
    private-keys:
      columns:
        - accounts.private_key
        - keypairs.private_key
        - fasp_providers.server_private_key_pem
      entity: PRIVATE_KEY
      operator: redact
    # Optional: mixed-content columns. Ruling them hides their non-personal content too; remove to keep it readable.
    mixed-content:
      columns:
        - admin_action_logs.human_identifier
        - admin_action_logs.recorded_changes
        - accounts.fields
        - bulk_import_rows.data
        - scheduled_statuses.params
        - generated_annual_reports.data
        - fasp_debug_callbacks.request_body
        - settings.value
      entity: MIXED_CONTENT
      operator: replace
```

**Choices**

- `identities.uid` is the user's id at the SSO provider: a username or e-mail address.
- `canonical_email_blocks.canonical_email_hash` is a guessable SHA-256 of an address; its token never equals the address's token.
- `users.otp_backup_codes` holds backup-code digests, so it sits in `passwords`.
- `web_push_subscriptions.endpoint` is redacted: with `key_auth` it lets anyone push to the user's browser.
- Optional parts: delete the commented profile and post columns you do not need and the `mixed-content` rule if the assistant needs those columns readable.

## Trade-offs

- **Indexed ruled columns:** `users.email`, `unconfirmed_email`, `confirmation_token`, `reset_password_token`; `canonical_email_blocks.canonical_email_hash`; `identities.uid`; `ip_blocks.ip`; `invites.code`; most token columns; `accounts.username`, `display_name` (public profiles).
- **Lookups that stop working:** a user by e-mail, sign-ups by IP, matching `ip_blocks`, a token or invite code; with public profiles, an account by username.
- **Join keys that stay unruled:** `id` and `<table>_id` columns, plus `users.account_id` and `oauth_access_tokens.resource_owner_id`.
- **`user_ips` view:** filters and groups on ruled IPs, so it is refused; query `login_activities` and `session_activations` by `user_id`.

## Not covered

- `accounts.note`, `avatar_description`, `header_description`, account URLs (which contain the username): public federated data.
- `custom_filter_keywords.keyword`, `custom_filters.phrase`, `lists.title`, `collections`: user-chosen labels.
- `email_domain_blocks.domain`, `username_blocks.username`, `domain_blocks.public_comment`: server policy.
- Media files, backups, Elasticsearch or OpenSearch, Redis: outside PostgreSQL.
